about_the_game:
Wandering Sword - Secrets of the Eastern Sea is an expansion DLC for the main game Wandering Sword.

A Mystical Encounter

A high-stakes gamble over a rare treasure sparks a brand-new adventure. Set sail and explore the mist-shrouded, enigmatic islands adrift upon the azure waves, embarking on a fresh journey through the martial world.

The Fan’s Dance

A mysterious divination maiden, her origins unknown, wields pearls as her wager and a fan as her blade. She ventures into the Central Plains in search of a destined one who can aid her in unraveling an ancient enigma. The lost martial art "Qingyun Fan Technique" resurfaces in the world—gentle as a breeze, deadly as a hidden edge. Can you grasp its secrets?

A Haven Beyond the World

Amidst the vastness of the martial world, there lies a place to call home. Carve out your own paradise on a nameless isle, where you can assign stewards to automatically gather resources and trade with wandering merchants. Additionally, the island features an arena where you can freely strategize and engage in exhilarating battles.

A New Beginning

Spend a small amount of Legacy Points in the "Appearance" tab of the Legacy Vault to unlock new outfits for Shangguan Hong and Sima Ling, along with two lively new mounts: a white seal and a gray seal.

short_description: A gamble about rare treasures opens a new journey. You will meet a young divination girl whose life is a mystery, explore the mysterious island, and recreate the lost martial arts. You can also open up a paradise and enjoy a moment of tranquility outside the conflict.
